title: JWJ #0247 - Exalted Universe Club
text:
Break #0247 details are below.
JWJ #0247 - Exalted Universe Club - Random Letter(s)
This is for one spot in the group break with a letter(s) being assigned randomly. You can purchase as many spots as you'd like as long as there are spots remaining. Teams will be randomized live on stream right before the break begins.
This break includes:
- (2) 2026 Topps Stadium Club WWE Hobby
- (2) 2026 Topps Universe WWE Hobby 
- (1) 2025 Topps Exalted WWE
Break will take place on our YouTube channel: youtube.com/@jwjbreaks on November 23rd.
20 total spots with the letters as follows:
A - Men
A - Women
B - Men
B - Women
C
D / E / F
G / H / I
J - Men
J - Women / W
K
L
M / N
O / P /Q
R - Men
R - Women / Z
S - Men
S - Women
T - Men (no "The")
T - Women (no "The")
U/V/X/Y/1
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
ALL CARDS WILL BE SHIPPED TO THE RESPECTIVE OWNER. (If you receive no cards a package will still be sent to you with courtesy pack(s))
NO REFUNDS, NO RETURNS, NO CANCELLATIONS FOR ANY PRODUCT AFTER RANDOMIZATION IS DONE!
Break Replay can be watched in the live stream replay on the JWJ Breaks YouTube channel.
- Please refer to our group break rules page for full details and rules for our breaking community. 
(PLEASE READ: By purchasing into this break you acknowledge that with trading card group breaks there is no guarantee that you will receive a specific team, player or card. The trading card products featured in this event are blind package model products with contents unknown to all participants involved at point of purchase including the breaker (JWJ Collector Breaks).
